lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5-6 horizontal tiers of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form a regular grid-like coordinate system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to a shadowed trough on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of significantly smaller luminance points across the cranial region and a dark, elongated silhouette of a commensal organism (remora) visible beneath the pectoral fin.
